title: Italien 2061 — ff72v–73r, 95v–96r, 97v–98r
contents: Italian diplomatic correspondence on Spanish funds and troops, papal involvement, France and Venice, ambassadors, and the Duke of Savoy.

excerpt: per questa volta, et dirli con queste sole parole **Che Dal** **Villeroy et Dal Amb.r Del Re Qui E Con querimonia Che F.P.** **Communica Con Riformati Di Francia** causa **Perche Non scriue Di sua mano** resto tutto
translation: For this occasion, I will say only this: Villeroy and the king’s ambassador here complain that F.P. communicates with the Reformed in France; this is why he does not write in his own hand. I remain wholly …
